The 73.69 high was rejected on 2026-11-05 (reversal to 68.71 on 4.4M shares, cause unknown) and the news feed and SEC filings were unavailable, so unseen event risk cannot be ruled out. Short interest above 15% of float means any adverse headline can produce a violent move, and the technical reward/risk of about 2.1 depends on a dip entry that has not happened; only about 1.2 is available to the nearby high.
